description: Test suite for XAI tool authentication helper functions, including resolving API keys and fallback mechanisms, based on configuration, environment, and plugin markers.

methods.name: isXaiToolEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the XAI tool is enabled based on provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiAuth
methods.description: Resolves fallback authentication information for XAI tools, prioritizing plugin markers, then legacy keys.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiApiKey

methods.name: resolveXaiToolApiKey
methods.description: Determines the API key to use for XAI tools, considering runtime config, source config, and environment variable fallback.
